title: RefineDef

max_level.description: Highest refine level. 0 turns refining off (then Levels is empty).

level.description: The level this step reaches (1 to max_level; the list is in order).

success_percent.description: Chance of success in whole percent, 1 to 100 (100 always succeeds). Rolled with the instance's random source.

material_item_id.description: The material item (item.*) the attempt uses up, success or not.

material_quantity.description: How many units of the material the attempt uses up. At least 1.

failure.description: What a failure does (RefineFailures): keep the level, go down one, or break the item.

items.description: One refine step of RefineDef: the attempt that reaches Level.

levels.description: One step per level, 1 to MaxLevel, in order.

description: The root of content/refine.yaml: how refining equipment works (ARCHITECTURE §6.8). One table for every refinable item, so it has no id. Levels has one step per level from 1 to MaxLevel, in order; step n is the attempt that takes an item from n - 1 to n. A refined item's level is the formula variable refine: its own modifiers use it, and a worn weapon's reaches combat. The player sees each step's chance, material and failure outcome before trying (the display bundle); nothing here is a drop rate.
